text_block_list.text:
Time flew by in the blink of an eye after the Make Debut,
and the day of the Asahi Hai FS had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...My outfit is in order.
Horseshoes... I checked them earlier."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you get nervous.
It's not like you to get nervous.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mmh, grr... It can't be helped, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"This is a GⅠ, you know? Even for me,
it's the first time standing on such a grand stage."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I want to face it in peak condition.
So as not to waste this opportunity."
choice_data_list: Go make this race another stepping stone for your growth.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thank you.
I'm off, then.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And next to make an appearance in the paddock
is this Umamusume... Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a GⅠ, the cheers are on a whole different level.
Is that over there a broadcast camera?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "It's a race watched by that many people, after all. ...Though I don't know if that child is watching."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Either way... I certainly don't want to lose.
